system.longDesc: A rifle is far more dangerous in your hands.

degree0.desc: You can assume a highly ready stance; as long as you are not moving more than half your normal speed, you can make an attack with a loaded rifle you are holding as a reaction before rolling initiative, even if surprised. This attack uses up your major action for the round, which means that you only have a minor action available during your next turn.

degree1.desc: You trust in your weapon’s power to punch through cover. The attack roll modifier for a target behind light cover does not apply to your attacks with a rifle. This includes the penalty from the Human Shield action stunt.

degree2.desc: Penalties to the attack roll due to range do not apply to your attacks with a rifle.
